title: learn-advice-row
description: One advice row of the report of `learn` (feature 106; a record not of annex B §B.20, so it stays internal to the package, $id in the internal form of row 32 of 'What the other features must follow'). One row per phase with enough work-seconds samples; the rows are written as indented JSON when an output is asked for, and printed one per line otherwise (F106-FR-023).

phase.description: The phase the row advises on

shape.description: The phase shape the row was computed under

knob.description: A member of the adjustable-knob allowlist (closed set 187)

current.description: The value in force (null: the knob has no current value in the fixture)

suggested.description: The suggested value, clamped into the hard bounds and rounded to the step; null when the evidence is not enough to suggest

target.description: The raw target the suggestion was derived from

work_sec_p50.description: The work seconds of the phase, p50

work_sec_p90.description: The work seconds of the phase, p90 — the sample of the proposer-timeout suggestion

work_sec_samples.description: The samples behind the percentiles; the denominator the floor checks

job_duration_p50.description: The yield-job duration of the phase, p50 — the sample of the poll-interval suggestion

reason.description: Why a suggestion was or was not made (floor not met, at the hard bound, no sample)
